variants.headline: Still in view: shipbuilding for the colony route
variants.sub: Shipbuilding by the home world has provided a larger vessel or another vessel for the colony route.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. The home world has built a larger ship or an additional ship for the colony route.

We remain critical of {target}. A shipbuilding development should not place transport stewardship beyond scrutiny; the colony deserves a demanding standard rather than automatic admiration for the announcement of a vessel.
